Leadership and board outcomes for each merger case

Source: R/leadership.R
merger_leadership.Rd

Classifies what happened to the two chief executives and the two boards, from the Part VII panel of build_merger_data() (donor and recipient rosters, t-2..t+2 on each organization's own calendar).

Usage

merger_leadership(part7)

Arguments

part7

The part7 table from build_merger_data().

Value

A data.table, one row per MERGER_ID with donor, recipient before, and recipient after rosters: CEO identities and flags, CEO_CAT, board counts and shares, and BOARD_CAT.

Details

CEO (one per organization): a person whose title matches CEO, executive director, president and CEO, administrator, or superintendent (not deputy, vice, assistant, board, or former), the highest paid if several; otherwise the highest-paid officer or key employee with pay above zero. The donor CEO comes from the donor's last roster at or before t0, and the recipient CEO from the recipient's last roster before t0. A CEO "remains" when the person appears anywhere on the recipient's roster at t+1 or t+2.

CEO_CAT:

  • recipient_ceo_only: the recipient CEO remains and the donor CEO does not join;

  • both_ceos: both remain at the recipient;

  • donor_ceo_only: the donor CEO joins and the recipient CEO leaves;

  • neither: both are gone;

  • shared_ceo: the same person led both before the merger, or the donor CEO was already on the recipient's roster.

Board (trustees and officers, plus 990-EZ listings, which have no position flags; excludes key employees and highest-paid staff who are not trustees or officers, and former officers). The recipient board before is the roster at t-1 (else t-2), after is t+1 (else t+2), and the donor board is its last roster at or before t0. BOARD_RETAIN is the share of the recipient board still there after; DONOR_JOINERS counts donor members on the board after who were not on it before; DONOR_SEAT_SHARE is their share of seats after.

BOARD_CAT:

  • intact_donor_dissolves: BOARD_RETAIN >= 0.5 and no donor joiners;

  • combine_minor: BOARD_RETAIN >= 0.5, joiners hold < 20% of seats;

  • combine_major: BOARD_RETAIN >= 0.5, joiners hold >= 20% of seats;

  • recipient_turnover: BOARD_RETAIN < 0.5.
